Fourier characters on the affine anti-L coset are orthogonal modulo L-pairing, so all fidelities invariant iff s*a*b=0 for every orbit, and normalized square defect is 8s^4 sum(ab)². Character parity forbids third mutually anticommuting transverse term alongside an active Q,Q* pair. Independent direct one-qubit matrix exponential, twirl, and Pauli fidelity checks matched n=1 examples including paired and unpaired errors. Exact conditions require static real amplitudes, all active transverse terms mutually anticommute, and error channel U†exp(-itH).
